BrochureContent.Content:
A beautifully presented and spacious three-bedroom detached Bungalow, No 10 St. Thomas  Crescent, enjoys a wonderful position within a quiet, highly regarded and well-maintained residential estate in Knock. The property is exceptionally bright and welcoming, with generous room proportions throughout and an abundance of natural light creating a warm and comfortable atmosphere.

The accommodation comprises a front entrance Porch and Hallway, a spacious Sitting Room with an open Fireplace, a well apportioned fitted Kitchen with an open plan Dining area providing an excellent space for every day family living and entertaining. There is also a separate Utility Room, three very large Bedrooms with fitted Wardrobes a family Bathroom as well as an adjacent W.C. The generous Bedroom accommodation provides excellent flexibility for families, guests or those seeking additional home-office space.

Externally the property is equally impressive. The front garden is beautifully maintained and provides an attractive approach to the House, while a fully tarmac driveway offers ample off-street parking. To the rear is a detached Garage, providing valuable additional storage or workspace.
The location is a particular feature of this property. No 10 St. Thomas Crescent is within easy walking distance of the renowned Basilica grounds in Knock and is approximately a 10-minute walk to all village local amenities and services. West International Airport Knock is only a 15-minute drive away with easy access also to three large Towns, notably been Claremorris, Ballyhaunis and Kiltimagh. This property therefore offers the ideal combination of peaceful residential living and excellent convenience.

Presented in a desirable and established location, this spacious detached Bungalow (1,220 sq. Ft) which comes with a D BER rating, represents an excellent opportunity for those seeking a comfortable home in a friendly and well-regarded community. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the generous accommodation, natural light and superb location this property has to offer.

To arrange a viewing or for any further information, please do not hesitate to contact the sole selling agent John Higgins Auctioneer on 094 9631372.
